tei:div.tei:p: 317) ༄༅// rdor sems thugs sgrub dang rtsa gsum sgrub khog sbrel ma'i 'don 'grigs rab gsal me long bzhugs/ 318)༄༅/

chos dbyings kun gsal yangs pa'i ngogs// mkhyen brtsi'i nyi ma zla ba'i gzi// phan tshun 'gran bzhin rmongs pa'i mun// bsal mdzad bla ma rdor sems rgyal// dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i spro gzhi rdor sems dang*// dkyil 'khor spyi yi sgrub khog zung 'brel bas// dkyil 'khor gcig shes kun grol phyir 'god na// dkyil 'khor lha dang bla mas gnang ba stsol// thog mar sgrub pa'i sna sel du// sāts+tsha gdab dang srog bslu dang*// rnam 'joms sme brtsegs khrus chog dang*// na raka dong sprugs yig brgya bzla// sems bskyed bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom// zhi ba'i sbyin sreg phyag bskor dang*// mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs skong bya// sgrub khang shar du sher phyin dang*// stobs po che lhor lang gshegs nub// tog gzungs gra lnga byang du bklag /mgron bzhir chu gtor mdos glud dang*// gtor ma lus kyi mchod sbyin bya// dngos su snang ba'i mgron bzhir yang*// mnyes byas sgrub pa'i gegs zhir smon// de nas sa yi cho ga la// dkyil 'khor gang du bya ba'i gzhir// tshom bu bkod mdun dkar gtor gnyis// gser skyems nyer spyod g.yas bskor bshams// bdag bskyed sman raka gtor gsum dang*// chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar bya// thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor ni// tshig bdun 319) gsol 'debs tshar gsum dang*/ khyab bdag dag po'i= brgyud 'debs rjes/ /badz+ra ma hā shrī= sogs nas/ /sho dha ya hūm̐ phaṭa bar gyis// bsang chu bsgrubs nas bdag bskyed kyi/ /bla ma rig 'dzin nas brtsams tai/ /stong pa nyid kyi ngang bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ slar yang rdo rje sems dpa'i= nas/ /kun la khyab= yan zin pa dang*// sgrub khog dbu nas oṃ badz+ra// a mri ta= sogs lhug 'don gyis/ /shab+dar zhi rol re re bya// sgrub khog mchod rol thams cad la// dung chen rgya gling dung dkar 'bud/

/skyob pa sangs rgyas= yo ga'i rtas/ /thim par gyur= la zhi rol bya// gtor ma dang po phyi rol mchod/ bhū mi pa ti nas nar 'don/ /dgongs shig sa bdag= yo ga'i rta// yo ga yin mod bzhi dril yin/ gshegs par bsam la zhi rol nang*// gtor ma gser skyems phyi rol dor// dbang phur slob dpon phyag tu phul/ /pad+ma ta krita= bdun mthar btab/ swa bhā ra thal mong la bzhag /rnam dag ye shes kyi zhing khams// chen por gyur= ces kha bsgyur bya// gegs gtor byin rlabs ram̐ yam̐ kham̐// stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las= sogs/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ bar rdor sems ltar/ sarba bhu ta a kar+sha ya dzaḥ sarba bigh+nān na maḥ sogs// lan gsum rnal 'byor chen po'i= nas/ /ha la hūm̐ bar rdor sems ltar/ / sgrub khog bdag gi thugs ka nas// phur pa gha ghas 320) byang shar btab/ khengs par gyur rjes bsam lhun 'don// rgyal tho bzhi dang sgo byang gnyis// dkar gtor bzhi dang dmar gtor gnyis// chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar bshams// ser sbreng shar tho'i mdun du 'khod/ /badz+ra a mri ta= sogs nas/ /shab+da ra thang gcig 'ur bzhag rol/ /sa ma dzaḥ la thang gsum 'ur// sum rdung gsang bdag spyan sngar 'don/ /brtan par bzhugs= la sum gcig 'ur/ bzhag rol shab+da ra thing gcig 'ur// bzhag rol kun srungs shig zhes la// sum gcig zil dang bzhag rol bya/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra me tog 'thor// rgyal tho'i rol mo rnams la ni// dung chen rgya gling dung dkar yod// lho nub byang gi rgyal tho la// mchod brlab gtor brlab shar tho ltar// rnga rdung 'don lugs snga ma bzhin// mnan dong nang du liṅga bting*// gser skyems bla ma'i phyag tu phul// sngags kyis byin brlab thang gsum 'ur// sum rdung rig 'dzin rtsa rgyud 'don/ khyad par rdor sems zhi khro= brjod// mtha' mar sum gcig 'ur bzhag rol/ /badz+ra ma hā shrī he ru// ko3haṃ e yaṃ raṃ= sogs nas/

/ 'gugs pa gsum la 'gugs rol te// mtha' mar dgu nas sum rdung gis// dam sri bya ba'i tshig gi nang*// skyer phur gdab cing thun rdzas brab// gu gul bdug cing dur rdo la// ri gling rgya gram bris pas mnan/ /'og tu mnan= la sum gcig 'ur/ / sa chu me rlung rim bcu gsum/ /sāts+tshad nag pos mnan sum brdung*/ /gcig ni= sogs nas 321) mthar sum gcig /'ur chem bzhag rol bro ra bskor/ hūm̐// nga ni 'jigs byed chen po ste/ khams gsum thams cad spyi nas gnon// dgra bgegs gdug can 'byung po rnams// dug gsum las kyi khang bur mnan// mnan no bcings so sa ma ya// rdo rje'i bro yis rgyas gdab pas// sus kyang 'jig par nus ma yin// oṃ lam̐ hūm̐ lam̐ stam+bha ya nan/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod me thun dang*// chu thun brab cing ram̐ yam̐ kham̐// stong pa'i ngang las a las= sogs/ /shab+da ra thang gcig 'ur bzhag rol/ /thub par mdzod la sum gcig 'ur// bzhag rol sngags kyis brtan par bya// mchod gtor byin rlabs mar blangs nas/ /nang sgor 'don lugs phyi sgo ltar// sgo them phur gdab sgo 'di nas// yan chad su yang ma 'da' brjod// gral du 'khod nas badz+ra dang*/ ma hā shrī he ru ko3haṃ// bdag nyid las kyi he ru= sogs/ /'gugs pa dam sri mnan pa ltar// 'gugs rol dgu nas sum rdung gis/ ma traṃ bya ba'i= sogs nas btang*/ /ma traṃ slob dpon zhabs g.yas mnan/ /tshul du mnan la sum 'ur bzhag /rtse gsum rgya yis snying gar gzir/ /gzugs phung hrul gyis zhig sogs brjod// bro ra bro mnan sngar ltar bya// ma traṃ lhu tshigs phyogs mtshams bkod// bh+rūm̐ dz+nyā na maṇ+ḍal= sogs bton// khog pa ye shes rol par bsgyur/ /pra we sha 322)ya= sa sgo phye la/ rdo rje'i 'gros kyis lan gsum bskor/ /phur gdan bcu bkod rang gi= sogs// tho phur bzung la yo ga'i rtas// tshigs bcad brjod la sngags kyis btab// chag chag g.yas bskor zhi rol bya/

oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ auṃ āḥhūm̐ sa ma s+t+waṃ// zhes brjod dal bus lha tshom bkod// las byang mchod pa byin rlabs nas// bstod pa yan chad bdag bskyed ltar// zhwa dang spos bcas thal byar nas/ /dus gsum bla ma= lan gsum brjod// lha rnams bar snang 'od drwar bzhugs/ /bi shwa zhi rol bum pa la/ / yungs dkar brab cing gu gul bdug oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ mang bzlas bum par bum rdzas blugs// dal bus mañji'i khar bzhag la// las byang mchod pa byin rlabs dang*// bsang sbyang stong pa'i ngang las= brjod/ /gu ru badz+ra satwa= la/ /puṣ+pe= sogs mchod zhi rol dang*/ /mi rtog rdo rje= sa bstod pa bya// gzungs thag blangs la rang gi= sogs/ satwa= stong dang yig brgya brgya/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs ro gcig gyur// ma hā kro dhi shwa ri brgya/ / las byang thig tshon hūm̐ badz+ra// hrika= sogs 'don la thig bskor bya/ lho nub rnga yab= brjod la grol// rdul tshon blugs la bshams bkod bya// phyir nyin nyin gung tsam tshogs la// tshig bdun gsol 'debs nas brtsam ste// bsnyen pa gsol gdab zhi rol yan// bdag bskyed kha sang 323) ltar du bya// 'dzab dbyangs zhi rol ring po'i nang*// slob dpon dril spos 'dzin pa'i rjes// sku gzugs gzhung pod rdor dril dang*// rnam bum gsang thod me long shel// sgrub gtor rnams thogs dkyil 'khor la// g.yas bskor gsum byas mdun du 'khod/ /bla med gsang ba= yo ga'i rtas// btang mthar zhi ri la ring po'i nang*// sgrub khog bzhin du sgrub rdzas bshams/ /bla med mchog= mthar zhi rol bya// rgyal theb zhwa bcas dbyangs bor len// las rdor thod chang drangs dang bstun/ /sangs rgyas gdung 'tshob= rjes zlos bya// ston pa'i sgron me bla ma dang*// rgyal tshab ston pa rgyal tshab rang*// kun bzang yum ni mchod yon che// rdo rje karma las tshan rnams// rdo rje ging mchog ging pa rnams// rdo rje mtshams pa sngags ram pa// rdo rje spyan pa dge bskos dang*// rdo rje dus mtshams mchod dpon rnams// rdo rje phyag tshang gnyer pa dang*// rdo rje byan po 'dren pa rnams// gser phreng mched lcam tshogs mang rnams// rdul phyag skyes bu sgo srung yin// dur khrod chas gsol ma byas chog

/snang srid 'khor 'das= yo ga'i rtas/ /pra tīts+tsha ho yan chad btang*// 'og gi rdor dril byin rlabs sngags// rol chen brgya rdung 'bring po bya/ zhwa bcas bzhengs la bdag nyid= sogs/ /tiṣ+ṭha lhan mthar zhi rol bya// thing gsum 'ur chem sum rdung gis/ dus gsum bde gshegs= nar 324) 'don mthar// brgyud gsum rol mo 'ur bzhag rol// 'dzab dbyangs lan gsum las byang gi /rang gi snying ga'i 'od kyi= nas/ /kun la khyab= mthar bsngo smon dang*/ /byin rlabs mchog stsol= bkra shis brjod// zhi rol sum khug byas la grol// thugs sgrub ltar du tshangs pa bca'// dngos gzhi'i nyi ma dang po nas// phyi nang 'grul 'grim rgyun bcad la// chu len la sogs 'gro ba la// phur chung yungs dkar btags pa bkur// mtshams nang 'ong dgos du yod kun// dmigs rdel dang po nas tshud bya// gsar du mi 'ong ka med kyang*// me thun chu thun brabs nas btsud// phyi mis sgrub bzhugs mthong mi rung*// mthong na mtshams ni bug pa yin// nang nas phyi mi mthong mi rung*// mthong na sgrub pa ral ba yin// de sogs sgrub chen bzhugs tshul rnams// rgyal dbang dpal yul ba yi srol// cung zad tsam yang nyams mi rung*// de nas dngos kyi 'don 'grigs ni// ltung bshags thub bstod le'u bdun// bar chad lam sel zab mdo sgron// sman chog sku gsum lo gyon rnams// zin nas tshig bdun gsol 'debs gsum/ khyab bdag dang po'i= lhug 'don bya// bla ma'i mdun du dung chu bshams// dkyil 'khor mdun du dkar bgegs bshams/ /badz+ra ma hā shrī= sogs nas/ ma hā kro dhi= brgya tsam bzla/ /khro mo dbyings phyug ma= sogs bton// sngags la bsang chu lan 325) gsum gtor// dung chu las bum nang du blug /las bum sgro yis dkar bgegs bran/ /ma hā kro dhi= tshar gcig dang*/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ sogs dkar bgegs brlab// rdor dril dang bcas bsdu rgya dang*// pad skor nam mdzod se gol bcas// lan gsum

gang dag= yo ga'i rta// zhi rol dung dkar rkyang pa 'bud// dkar gtor gser skyems phyi rol dor/ sarba bigh+nā= rgya sngar ltar/ /rnal 'byor chen po'i= yo ga'i rta// bgegs gtor dor la zhi rol bya/ /bi shwa= yungs thun gu gul bdug /zhi rol de gnyis dung chen rgyun// rdor dril gdan steng du bzhag /sa mā dzaḥ la bsdu rgya dang*/ /bla ma dpal ldan= khrus gdangs kyis// thal sbyar dang bcas lan gsum 'don/ /badz+ra muḥ las bsdu rgya bya/ /swa bhā wa= sogs mchod rlabs bton/ shab+da= zhi rol rgya gling dang*// dkar dung dung chen 'bud par bya// bla ma ḍā ma ru yang bsgrag /sman raka gtor rlabs sngags gsum re/ /s+pha ra ṇa ra se gol spro/ 'khor 'das= yo ga bzhi dril yin// de ltar lhug 'don rdor dril sang*/ /sa ma dzaḥ la bsdu rgya dang*// dril bcas spyan 'dren bum gdangs bya/ /zhi rol rgya dkar dung ḍā bya/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang rgya dang*/ /oṃ hūm̐ dbang rgya a dhi la/ / thal mo nang bskor truṃ la/ /thal mo'i gsham ni sgra med brdab/ /dpag med= yo ga bzhi dril yin/ /pa na= pad bskor g.yas g.yon mdun/ 326) /sngags la dril bcas rang rgya bya/ /shab+da= zhi rol rgya dkar ḍā/ /rdor sems thog mthar dung chen ni// 'bud srol med mod bus na yang*// 'gal ba med dang mdzes chos phyir// bstod pa yo ga tshig rkang bzhir// rdor gsor dril bsil pad skor gnyis/ /rdor sems rgya dang thal sbyar 'gre/ / rdor dril sar bzhag bdag gi lhug /badz+ra satwa= stong phrag dang*// yig brgya brgya rtsa bzla bar bya/ /dpal ldan= khrus gdangs thal sbyar mthar// zhi rol dkar rgya dung ḍā bya// mchod rol sil snyan nam bsgrag la// mang mas dril bu phyogs bkrol yin// rnga tshig sbubs chal nam bsgrag la// bla ma rkyang pas dril bu dkrol// de dag spyi la shes rgyu yin/ /rang gi snying ga 'i lhug 'don bya/ dwangs ma'i= man chod sman gdangs yin/

/ngo bor gyur= yan zin pa dang*// gong gi snying ga'i sa bon= nas/ /mngon du gyur= bar mar la blang*// gdangs dang rol mo sngar ltar yin// rdo rje dril bu sar bzhag la// de nas tshogs rten= sogs nas btang*/ /gang gi= phyag gdangs thal sbyar yin/ bde bar gshegs so= yo ga'i rtas/ /pa na pe nu= pad bskor gsum// zhi rol rgya dkar dung chen btang*/ /dpag med= mchod gdangs thal sbyar gyis// sngags la pad gnyis rang rgya dang*// se gol gnyis re bsnol mar bstab/ /shab+da= zhi rol dkar rgya dung*/ /mi dbang= mchod gdangs thal sbyar nas/ 327) /sngags la pad gnyis nam mdzod rgya// se gol gnyis re gdangs dus yin// lhug dus pad gcig rang rgya dang*// se gol gcig gtogs kun la 'gre/ /na bza' rgyan phreng= gnyis rang rgya/ /mchod pa'i= yo ga bzhi dril btang*// nang mchod g.yas btegs sman mchod bton// g.yon pa'i theb srin thig gtor gyi/ /oṃ mchod= sogs bton ṣ+wa me= la/ lcer myang nang mchod mdun du bzhag /sha lnga= ya ོ ga sngags dril bsil// bstod pa 'don lugs bdag bskyed ltar/ /'di ni sangs rgyas= spya ི phyag yin// rdor dril sar bzhag 'dzab dmigs btang*// yig drug stong dang yig brgya brgya// 'di skabs bsnyan rgyun bsnyen pa 'dzug /dngos grub len chog ma tshar bar// nyin mtshan snyen rgyun chad mi rung*// chad na sgrub pa don med yin// do gal nan tan 'di la mdzod// 'di dus dge slong bzhi sde tsam// rgyal tho sgo byang tho gsol phebs// nyin re bzhin du chad med dgos// nyin gsum mtshan gsum chag med pa'i// dngos grub bskul ba'i bsang gsur bya/ /thun mthar dpal ldan= khrus gdongs dang*// zhi rol rgya dkar dung ḍā btang*/ /dkyil 'khor gyi= sogs yig brgya la/ da ha= sbyar ba brgya tsam bzla// bye yungs khrus btab gtso bo= sogs/ /mi za'o= yan 'di man chad// yo ga lhug 'don spel ma yis/

/ye shes thugs rje gang zhig= dang*/ /rnal 'byor bdag ni= bskul 328) mtshams yin/ /bde bar= yo ga bzhi dril yin/ /bskang ngo= bskang gdangs mtshams rnams su/ /zhi rol dkar rgya dung chen btang*// mtha' mar rol med rjes chog gi /mchod brlab zhi rol mchod par rol/ /mi rtog rdo rje= spyi phyag yin/ ma rnyed= ya ོ ga thal sbyar dung*/ /rang gi snying ga'i= lhug 'don bya/ /oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub gyur= brjod// dkyil 'khor mdun du lcags hom du// nyul+le'i ling ga khrag gis bran// sgrub khog e yam̐ ram̐= sogs brjod// 'gugs pa tshar gcig zhi rol dang*// dung chen rkang dung bzhi 'bud btang*// drag sngags so lnga phur pas gzir// zhi rol

gha ta sa gu gul 'grim// thun bran zhi rol dung chen brgyud/ /zhwa bcas 'phags mchog thugs rje= dbyangs// bzhi dril zhi rol sum khug sbir// rgya dkar dung ḍā g.yab dar btang*// zhwa phud rdor dril sar bzhag la// 'dzab dbyangs gsum bya snga thun tshar// de nas nyin thun gnyis pa ni/ /bla ma rig 'dzin= nas bzung ste// las sbyor tshab tu bum bsnyen bya// 'dzab dbyangs yan chad snga thun ltar// nyin thun gsum pa brgyud 'debs dang*/ /bla ma rig 'dzin= nas bzung nas// skong ba yan chad zin pa dang*// dam can spyi gtor bstod pa yan// bla ma yi dam lta bu yi// gter mdzod gtor bsngos gang rung bya// dngos grub rol mtsho'i sngags srung ngam// chags med 329) sngags srung gang rung 'don/ /gter gzhi kun 'grub mdzod= yan btang*// spro na na raka skong bshags 'don// las rdor phyag bcas tshogs zhus bya// las chu nang mchod bdud rtsi dang*// tshogs chang gsum po tshogs la bran/ /sarba dra byaṃ= sogs nas 'don// spyan 'dren yo ga bzhi dril dang*// zhi rol mchod pa zhi rol bya// dkar rgya dung chen ḍa ru yod/ /shab+da= bzhi rdeb kha 'bud med/ /gzugs sgra= yo ga zhi rol la// dkar rgya dung chen thog med la// yo ga zhi rol kha 'bud med/ skong chen lnga dang dag gyur= bcas/ / gdangs dril rol mo sngar ltar mthar// yig brgya 'gugs par 'dod rgyal rgya/ /nga ni za byed= yo ga dang*// zhi rol dung chen bstab pa la// zhi rol dung chen lha tshogs= btang*// las rdor tshogs drang bla mas lan/ cha gsum bka' ma ltar du bya// bdag 'jug khrus gdangs lhug 'don spel// khrus la las rdor las chu 'thor// maṇ+ḍal sa gzhi spos chus= btang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje= 'dzab mtha' dang*/ /bla ma dpal ldan= 'go nas blang*/ /bde gshegs sras bcas= bsdus pa rang*/ /rang nyid dpal= nas shar 'don la// zhi rol sum khug rkang dung dang*// dkar rgya dung ḍā g.yab dar bya/

/tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra nas mgor bzhag /maṇ+ḍal sa gzhi= byang chub= gsum/ /shab+da ra zhi rol dkar rgya dung*// dbang rnams slob dpon 330) rkyang pas blang*// dbang tshig dbang gdangs che chung spel/ /gtso bos ji ltar= khrus gdangs yin/ /maṇ+ḍal sa gzhi spos chus= bya/ /gdod nas lhun grub= lhug 'don rjes// las rdor phyag bcas lhag zhus bya/ /shab+dar zhi rol dung dkar btang*// lhag ma yo ga bzhi dril dang*// zhi rol kha 'bud sngar ltar yin// spyi gtor 'gugs nas bkra shis yan// tshigs bcad mgo nas zhwa bzhes btang*// chad tho yo ga rol dung chen// brtan ma yo ga zhi rol la// rgya gling dung chen zhwa yar phud// mchod rlab rol dkar rgya dung ḍā// mchod par zhi rol dkar rgya dung*/ mi rtog= yo ga spyi phyag yin/ /ma rnyed= yo ga thal sbyar la// yig brgya dril bsil lan gsum brjod/ /'dir ni= yo ga sngags nas 'thor/ /rang gi snying ga'i= lhug 'don dal/ ngang du gyur= las cung zad bzhag oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥ slar yang rdo rje= gnas gsum reg /kā wā tsi= la khu tshur bsnol/ /kun la khyab= la rdor dril pang*// zhwa pang bsngo smon yo ga dang*// bkra shis yo ga me tog 'thor// zhi rol brgyud gsum kha 'bud yod// bzang spyod rgyal ba kun gyi= btang*// de ltar zhwa bzhes gral nas bzhengs// nyul+le'i ling ga gral mdor bkod// 'gugs pa gsum la 'gugs rol re/ /chos kyi= drag rol che ba dang*/ /nga ni= drag rol chung bas btang*/ /shar phyogs= drag rol 'bring 331) ba yin// zil mthar sum rdung gis byin 'bebs/ /dus gsum bde gshegs= sngar ltar btang*// 'dzab dbyangs gsum dang yig brgya'i rgyun// mtshan thun gsum la nyin mo'i thun// gnyis pa ltar du cha tshang btang*// thun pa rnams kyis rdor sems kyi// rgyun khyer btang la bsnyen thun bzung*// thun mthar bkra shis yan chad btang*// phyi mas bsnyen par ma slebs bar// snga mas thun mtha' mi bsdu'o// nam lang tshe na bsnyen rgyun gyis// bsnyen par slebs dus thun pas bsdu// nub mo thun pas bzlas pa la// sleb tshe bsnyen rgyun pas mtha' bsdu// las la bsko dus khrus chu 'gyed// nang par bdud rtsi chos sman dang*// dung 'gyur za yig yod na bkye// dung 'gyur sngags kyang thog mar 'don// mtshan mo dka' las mi blta lang*// zhag bdun sgrub pa 'dug pa la// lo bdun mtshams dang phan yon 'dra// zhag bdun sgrub pa 'di yi tshe// ngag bcad ma thub thabs med yin// nyi ma drug pa'i thun dang po'i// byin 'bebs rjes su a mtshar phyir// rgyun gyi dngos grub len spro na/

sgrub khog bde gshegs= yo ga dril// zhi rol kha 'bud cha tshang bya// rdor sems gzhung gi sman mchod kyi/ /chos sku kun tu bzang po de// mchod do oṃ āḥhūm̐ bskyur/ 332) /gdangs dang lag len sngar rgyun ltar// nyin bdun nyin thun gsum pa yi// mdun bskyed bum bsnyen tshar ba dang*// dngos grub rdzas rnams gzhung ltar bshams/ /sgrub khog slar yang rang gi= sogs/ /yig drug yig brgya so so la// dngos grub sngags btags brgya re bzla// sbyin bsreg bya sar sa slong dang*// nang du sbyin sreg lha tshom bkod// de nub dngos grub skul chog bya// phyir nang shin tu snga bar lang*// cho ga sngar ltar btang ba yi// bum bsnyen rjes su dngos grub bsnyen/ bsnyen rgyun pas kyang de nyid rgyun// gsol ka tshogs bskang rgyas par byed// bsgral bstab dus su nyul+le'i rten// mer bsreg rnal 'byor chen po yis// bgegs bskrad zhi rol 'phags mchog= mas// byin 'bebs zhi rol sum khug bya/ ye shes sku mchog= lhug 'don dang*/ /lha dang rig 'dzin= yo ga'i rta/ /pha la hūm̐ āḥ zha ི rol bya/ /de ltar rtse gcig= lhug 'don dang*// yig drug yig brgya so so'i gshams/ /kā ya sid+dhi= btags pa rgyun// skya rengs shar dus sgrub rdzas btegs/ /ye shes lus can= yo ga dang*// gong gi bde gshegs rgyal ba= 'don// zhi rol dal myur spel ma yis// sgrub rdzas thams cad dngos grub len// rdor sems bdag 'jug rgyas par blangs// sbyin sreg thig tshon rdzas rnams bsag /rdor sems bdag 333) bsnyen bzlas pa dang*// gsol gdab bsdu ldang rdo rje dril// byin brlabs sngags ni sgrub khog ltar// las byang mchod pa byin brlabs 'don/ /oṃ swa hā= nas gsal bar gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang 'og rdzas sngags/ /bho dhi brik+ṣa= nas a pra/ /yan chad tshar gsum gong gi 'phro/ /dz+wa las me sbar zhi rol dang*/

hūm̐ hūm̐= rlung g.yab zhi rol bya/ /ag+nis mar khu blugs pa dang*/ /satwa= ku sha swā hā rol/ /ma hā kro dhi swa bhā ba// stong pa'i ngang las lhug 'don dang*/ /tshur gshegs= yo ga zhi rol bya/ /mtshan par bsam= la ag+ne ye/ /bdun gyis bkang la dī bya rol// de 'dra lan gsum bdag cag= sogs/ /shab+da= zhi rol gzi brjid la/ /phyed phyag dril bsil gsum pa yin// rdzas sngags bdun la 'dod gsol gcig /zhi rol re re dī bya= yan/ /yungs dkar 'thor la drang srong= sogs/ /thab kyis dbus su e las= sogs/ /mdun bskyed ltar btang sgrub mchod ltar// gdan gsal spyan 'dren tshom bu drangs// rol ring dzaḥhūm̐= yig brgya gcig /thab kyi dkyil 'khor= sogs mdun bskyed/ /gsal bar gyur= rjes mdun bskyed kyi// phyag nas bstod pa'i bar du btang*/ dkyil 'khor= sogs nas ram̐ yig gis// mtshan par bsam= la satwa= bdun// yig brgya tshar gcig zhi 334) rol dang*// de 'dra gsum gyis dgang blugs 'bul/ /satwa= tshar gcig rdzas sngags bcu// 'dod gsol tshar gcig rol mo te// yam shing nas bzung ku sha yan// tshar bcus sbyin sreg stong rtsa 'grub// yungs dkar yig brgyas thab tu gtor/ /bdag cag= sogs kyi 'dod gsol sbyar/ / slar yang dgang blugs nyer gcig 'bul// bdag bskyed sman raka mchod tshig gis// lha gzhung gtor ma me nang 'bul// rjes chog mchod rlab mchod bstod dang*/ /ma rnyed yongs su= bshags pa'i rjes/ /badz+ra muḥ sogs tshom bu gshegs// rol ring dam tshig rang la bsdu/ dz+wa la 'a ི sngags kyis mar khu 'bul/ /slar yang me lha= sogs btang la/ /ag+ni= bdun dang dī bya= gcig zhi rol de 'dra lan gsum dang*// yam shing nas bzung ku sha yan// gsum res sreg rdzas sngar ltar 'bul/ /ag+ni a ka ro sa me lha'i/ /gtor ma me nang 'phul ba dang*/ /me ste bsreg bya= cha gsum ltar/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma sa phrin las bcol/
